transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Um, hi. Thank you for seeing me. I hope I'm in the right place. My mom mostly made the appointment, but... I guess things have just been a little slow for me lately? 

I don't want to sound like I'm complaining or anything, it's just... I can't really seem to make myself do much of anything anymore. I just sort of sit in my room. I haven't even been changing my clothes, which I know sounds really bad, I'm sorry. I just... I don't knit or journal or go on walks like I used to. And when my mom asks me what's wrong, I just... I barely have the energy to even answer her. 

Is that... does that make sense? I hope I'm explaining it okay.
How long have you been feeling this way?

Um, well... I guess it's been a while? I mean, it wasn't all at once, so it's hard to say exactly. But... maybe around the time I started the community college program? 

That was, um, about two years and two months ago, I think? I don't want to make it sound like it's been this terrible, dramatic thing the whole time, because it hasn't. It's just sort of... slowly gotten to this point. I hope that's a helpful answer? I'm not always great at remembering timelines, I'm sorry.
Do you still enjoy the things you used to like doing, like knitting or journaling, or has that changed for you?

Um, no, not really. I mean, I don't want to sound like I'm ungrateful for the hobbies I have, but... I just can't seem to make myself do any of it anymore. 

Like I mentioned before, I just sort of sit in my room. And I know I said this already, and I'm really sorry if it sounds gross, but I just stay in the same clothes. I don't knit or journal, and I don't go on my walks. It's just... I don't know, it's like the energy isn't there? Even when my mom tries to talk to me about it, I barely have the energy to give her an answer. 

I feel really bad about it, honestly. I hope I'm not coming across as lazy or anything. Does that answer your question okay?
Do you still find pleasure in the things you used to enjoy?

Um... I'm sorry, I know I just talked about this a little bit, so I hope it's okay if I say the same sort of things again? I don't want to waste your time. 

But, um... no, I don't really feel that spark of happiness from them anymore. It's not that I hate my hobbies now, it's just... I mostly just can't make myself do anything. Like I was saying, I end up just sitting in my room all day. And, um, still wearing the same clothes, which I know is really embarrassing to admit again, I'm sorry. 

The joy just isn't really there to get me to go walking or open my journal or pick up my knitting needles. And it takes so much out of me that when my mom asks what's wrong, I just... I barely have the energy to even give her an answer. 

I'm really sorry, I feel like I just gave you the exact same answer as before. Am I doing this right? I hope I'm giving you what you need to know.
Have you been having any thoughts about hurting yourself or wishing you weren't alive?

Um... oh, no. No, I haven't been having thoughts like that. I mean, I know I've been feeling really drained and just sort of... stuck in my room, but it's not like I want to hurt myself or anything. 

I'm really sorry if the way I was describing things made it sound like that. I definitely don't want you to think I'm in that kind of danger, because I'm not. I just... I just don't have a lot of energy right now. But I'm okay in that way, I promise. 

Is it okay that I said no? I hope I'm not giving you the wrong idea about how I'm doing.
Have you experienced any changes in your appetite or sleep patterns?

Um, no, not really. I mean, I think I'm sleeping okay? I usually just lay in bed a lot anyway, since I'm in my room all day, so I guess it feels about the same. And my appetite... um, I think it's fine. My mom brings me food sometimes, and I try to eat what she makes so she doesn't worry. 

I'm really sorry, I know that's not a very detailed answer. I just haven't really noticed a big difference, I don't think. I hope that's okay? I can try to pay more attention to it if you want me to.
Have you had any days where you felt somewhat better and were able to do a few things, or has it been this way almost every day?

Um... I really wish I could tell you that I've had some good days lately. I know I should be trying harder to get up and be productive, and I'm really sorry if it sounds like I'm just not trying. 

But, um... I think it's mostly just been this way almost every day. Just sort of... the same. I haven't really noticed a day where I felt a lot better and could actually do things. 

I hope it's okay to admit that? I really don't want you to be disappointed in me, or think I'm not cooperating or anything. I'm trying my best to be honest with you. Am I doing okay with answering your questions?
How often do you feel like you're unable to take care of yourself or your daily responsibilities?

Um... well, I guess... I'm really sorry to admit this, because I know I should be doing more. I don't want you to think I'm just giving up or being lazy, I promise I'm not. But... um, it's been pretty hard to keep up with things lately. 

I actually... I had to stop moving forward in my certificate program. Just for right now, hopefully! I just... I realized I wasn't able to handle the practicum part of it. And, um, because of that, I can't really plan for the clinic office job I was working toward. 

I feel really terrible about it, and I'm so sorry if that's disappointing to hear. I'm going to try to get back to it when I have a little more energy. Is it okay that I took a step back? I just didn't want to mess it up and cause problems for anyone at the clinic. I hope you understand... did that answer your question okay?
How many months would you say you've been feeling this low, without any significant improvement?

Um... gosh, I hope you won't be upset with me for letting it go on this long without getting better. I really have been trying to pull myself out of it, I promise. 

But, um... I guess this whole decline has sort of been going on since I started the community-college program. That was about... two years and two months ago, I think? 

I'm so sorry, I know I probably should have asked for help way before now. I just kept hoping I could fix it myself so I wouldn't be a burden to anyone. Is it... is it really bad that it's been that long? I hope I didn't ruin my chances of getting better by waiting. I really am ready to do whatever you think is best now.
Are there any activities that you still find pleasure or enjoyment in?

Um... I really wish I had a better answer for you. I know I should be keeping up with my hobbies, and I'm so sorry to disappoint you. I hope you don't think I'm just being difficult or lazy. But... mostly I just can't seem to make myself do anything anymore. 

I used to really like knitting, and writing in my journal, and going for walks... but I just don't do those things right now. I feel really embarrassed admitting this, but lately I just sit in my room... sometimes I even leave the same clothes on for a while. I know that sounds awful, and I'm so sorry. Even when my mom comes in and asks what's wrong, I... I barely even have the energy to answer her. 

I really want to enjoy things again, I promise I do. I'm going to try to do better. Is it okay that I don't have any fun activities to tell you about today? I hope I'm still answering your questions right...

I don't really have a different timeline to give you, I'm sorry. I hope you're not frustrated with me. Did you mean something else? I really want to make sure I'm giving you the right information... am I doing this okay?

Um... oh, I'm so sorry. I... I think I might have answered this a second ago, and I really hope I'm not being difficult by repeating myself. I just want to make sure I'm giving you what you need.

I really promise I'm not trying to be lazy or uncooperative. It's just... mostly I just can't make myself do anything anymore. 

I'm so embarrassed to say this again, but I just sit in my room... and I wear the same clothes... and when my mom tries to talk to me or asks what's wrong, I just barely have the energy to even answer her. I really am trying my best to answer you right.

I really wish I could say yes. I know I should be trying harder to find little things to enjoy. But... like I mentioned, I just can't seem to make myself do anything. I really, really wish I could tell you that I'm finding things fun. I know I should be doing my hobbies... I know I should be knitting, or writing in my journal, or going for my walks. I'm so sorry I don't have a happier answer for you. Am I... is there something else I should be saying? If you tell me what you need to hear, I can try to do better. I really want to be helpful... am I doing this completely wrong?
